message.content: {"caption":"A flow diagram of trajectory collection, skill storage, and model refinement.","description":"The upper row shows an orange-fish Base Model interacting with an Environment, indicated by circular arrows. A right-pointing arrow leads from the Environment to a Trajectory made of actions a₁, a₂, …, aₙ. Dashed arrows branch from the trajectory to a green check labeled “Successful Episodes” and a red cross labeled “Lessons from Failure”; a solid right-pointing arrow leads from this area to a black cube labeled “Memory.” A line from Memory descends and ends in a downward arrow at a folder labeled “Skills.” In the lower panel, a red feedback line runs above the models and has a downward arrowhead over the Evolved Model, shown as an orange fish with a flame symbol. An Environment is to its right, with a left-pointing arrow toward the Evolved Model. Farther right, an orange-fish SFT Model is labeled “Cold Start” and is shown with circular interaction arrows beside the Environment. The Skills area contains a “General Skills” box above a “Task-Specific Skills” box. Arrows from these categories point right toward examples: General Skills connects to an orange linked-nodes symbol and the note “Take what you see,” and to a search/document symbol and “Prioritize exploring unvisited nodes.” Task-Specific Skills connects to a process icon and the instruction “For cleaning tasks, follow this process: Locate -> Obtain -> Clean the pool -> Place this item.” Blue feedback paths run along the bottom, with upward arrowheads into the SFT Model and Task-Specific Skills area. The bottom labels are a flame symbol with “Update SkillBank” and a blue plus with “Create New or Refine,” followed by an edit icon. The check and cross distinguish successful episodes from failure lessons; the flame marks skill-bank updating.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
